answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 11372 Country: India Title: aslamualaikum...my question is to ref of my question with id 10502(in urdu).u r telling me that i shud sent a written to the adress which i have already done .once i sent the letter to thye adress which is written on certificate...but ther was no reply ...2)if machine is used to halal the chicken and bismillah is recited by a man tahn can it be considered halal if yes will bismillah be recited on each and every chisken or only on first ? one?...4) Question: aslamualaikum...my question is to ref of my question with id 10502(in urdu).u r telling me that i shud sent a written to the adress which i have already done .once i sent the letter to thye adress which is written on certificate...but ther was no reply ...2)if machine is used to halal the chicken and bismillah is recited by a man tahn can it be considered halal if yes will bismillah be recited on each and every chisken or only on first ? one?...4) Answer ID: 11372 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 341/321=B/1430) If the machine is on and the chickens are slaughtered while a person is reciting bismillah or a recorder is played, then this slaughtering is not valid and the meat will not be halal. Rather, the slaughtering will be valid only when a person recites bismillah and slaughters the animal. Only by reciting bismillah on first chicken, the other ones will not be halal, it is necessary to recite bismillah while slaughtering every chicken. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
